common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one finished detailed One Piece anime fishing-rod game sprite, NOT a whole character, NOT a set. Professional anime prop key-art: mature confident tapered ink linework, expressive asymmetrical silhouette, carefully drawn dimensional construction, clean 3-tone hand-painted cel shadows and narrow highlights, fine material detail placed selectively. Clearly One Piece anime, not simplistic vector/clipart, not chibi, not a photoreal 3D render, not generic fantasy jewelry. One entire straight HORIZONTAL fishing rod pointing RIGHT, butt at 6% image width, tip at 94%, shaft axis at 46% height. Wide 3:1 landscape composition, whole silhouette inside generous transparent margins. TRUE transparent background with clean alpha outside solid object; NO background, haze, smoke, glow, vignette, floating particles, drop shadow, words, lettering, characters, fish, dangling line or hook. A real usable rod with a grippable handle at the leftmost 18%, plausible compact reel/spool/crank at left 20-28%, a straight unobstructed tapered slim flexible upper 60% with six line guides. Character-specific solid structures integrated into the lower rigid 35-40%; do not scatter symbols along a plain stick. Beautiful bold structure plus painstaking seam lines, panel edges, wraps and controlled drawn surface shading. Design brief:
